posts.text: The rain finally stopped and the whole street smells like wet pavement. Measured 56 mm of rain overnight, the garden is very happy. Third attempt at sourdough today and it actually worked. Small win: fixed a bug that has been haunting me for 14 weeks. Hot take: Rust error messages are better than most documentation. Took 63 photos at the riverside path and exactly one of them is in focus. Our tiny team shipped release 8.4 after 45 days of testing. Accidentally made enough ramen for 73 people. Neighbours are getting some. cc @odubois99 🌱 #Books
